p7.room.session.started.v1.description: P7 room session entered active state.

p7.room.session.ended.v1.description: P7 room session entered ended state.

p7.room.command.failed.v1.description: P7 rejected or failed a room command.

comfy.collab.prompt.v1.description: Creator-collab slice 3: a creative prompt was submitted to a ComfyUI collab session in a room. Carries parent_prompt_id for chain-of-edits. Published by creator-collab surfaces (notebook-workbench, creator-canvas-primary); consumed by comfy-watcher / comfyui / pinokio_bridge.

comfy.collab.progress.v1.description: Creator-collab slice 3: progress update for a running ComfyUI workflow (phase, percent, current_node, step). Linked to the parent prompt via prompt_id. Published by comfy-watcher / comfyui; consumed by nats_event_bus and the room sidebar.

comfy.collab.artifact.v1.description: Creator-collab slice 3: a ComfyUI workflow produced an artifact (image/video/audio/model/text). Linked to the parent prompt via prompt_id. Published by comfy-watcher / comfyui; consumed by notebook-workbench + creator-canvas-primary to surface the artifact in the room.

room.presence.v1.description: Creator-collab slice 3: presence event for a room — join/leave/focus/blur/active. Emitted by room UIs and P7. Consumed by nats_event_bus + room sidebar to render the active collaborator list.

room.directory.v1.description: Creator-collab slice 3: snapshot of the room directory (every known room with its stage, hardware summary, apps_count, skills_count). Published by p7-room-orchestrator on catalog reload or stage transition. Consumed by nats_event_bus, dashboard, room-suggest-skill, pmoves-helpdesk-skill.

helpdesk.intake.opened.v1.description: Creator-collab slice 6: a visitor opened an intake session in pmoves.room.helpdesk. Carries the intake_id, agent_id, optional intent hint, and the room directory snapshot version used for routing. Emitted by pmoves-helpdesk-skill at session-open. Consumed by nats_event_bus + dashboard to render intake traffic.

helpdesk.intake.routed.v1.description: Creator-collab slice 6: the helpdesk routed an intake to a target room + optional fleet node. Carries the parent intake_id, target room_id, routing rationale, and the structured intent match for debugging + persona-aware ranking. Emitted by pmoves-helpdesk-skill after visitor acceptance or auto-route. Consumed by nats_event_bus + dashboard to surface intake outcomes.

helpdesk.room.suggested.v1.description: Creator-collab slice 6: room-suggest-skill produced a ranked list of candidate rooms for a persona + intent. Carries the suggestion_id, persona context (agent_id + role), the ranked candidates with persona-aware scores, and the directory snapshot version. Emitted by room-suggest-skill on every chat turn (ambient) or on the room-suggest UI (explicit). Consumed by nats_event_bus + room-suggestions panel.

studio.render.completed.v1.description: ComfyUI render completed in DARKXSIDE content studio

voice.synth.request.v1.description: Voice synthesis request from DARKXSIDE TTS studio

room.desktop.session.opened.v1.description: E2B shared desktop session opened in DARKXSIDE room
